title: TheMakrin's Immersive Servers
description: Economy and cave dimension for your server
body:
### If you want to have features from this mod, it must be installed on both client and server!
![iServers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d51ce5f1019e4ff557e5488f810aa708fcf0c15_0.webp)
Hi, im TheMakrin. Recently I wanted to create server, and needed coins system and cave dimension, so I developed it.

## This mod adds:

**CAVE DIMENSION!**

**_also:_**

**Craftable coin**

![Craftable Coin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9b9107e3eaa3f2bfdadb9a6ec54ca9c82663116.png)

**Craftable Gem**

![Craftable Gem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5fac6112ab3f0ad44e636f7ee5d9b0c5d9806502.png)

**Craftable Wallet**

![Craftable Wallet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c9e99cf6e65935ebdf034e0f369bddeba964082.png)

**Cave Portal Activator**

![It's craftable!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab3c73fa83ab0d24a04db1c2d041a3d0af0c8b81_0.webp)

**You can fill wallet with gems:**

![It's easy!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee143d6aa73b8edd78ba27d38abdcd1b1438de49.png)

_You also can craft gem back in coins._
